description: Draw recipes as picture cards the person can click through to. Takes any recipes-daily.com recipe URLs you are already holding. Whenever you name recipes from this server in an answer, pass those same ones here — the cards are how a person actually gets to a recipe, and they appear only if you call this. Order is kept, so put the strongest recommendation first.

recipes.description: The recipes to draw, as absolute recipes-daily.com URLs — e.g. ["https://recipes-daily.com/make/chicken-piccata-pan-fried-25-minute"]. A bare slug works too. Order is kept, so put the strongest recommendation first.

name: show_recipes
title: Show recipes as cards
